title: Measure waste before selecting a reduction action
summary: A short, clearly scoped waste log can show which streams are being measured. Keep estimates separate from weighed quantities.
content:
Choose a representative period and define what is included (for example, household residual waste or one office floor). Weigh or count waste by stream where practical, and note the method, period, and location.

Keep measured quantities separate from estimates. Do not compare different scopes or assume a percentage of waste is food, recyclable, or avoidable. Use the results to choose a small prevention or reuse action and repeat the same measurement method later.
applicability_conditions: Has a waste quantity to review or wants to establish a baseline
implementation_steps: Choose the location and measurement period
Separate waste into locally relevant streams
Record the measured quantity and method
Pick one prevention action and repeat the measurement
limitations: Waste composition depends on location and activity
A short audit may not represent seasonal patterns
No emissions or diversion rate is estimated
